procedure_name: Beti Bachao / Ladli Kanya Financial Incentive Scheme
summary: Fixed deposit financial aid deposited in the name of girl children at birth, school admissions, and upon turning 18.

steps.title: Registration at birth of girl child
steps.description: Apply within 1 year of girl child birth at government hospital or Anganwadi center.

steps.title: Parent residency & family income check
steps.description: Parents must have resided in state for 3+ years with annual income under prescribed limit.

steps.title: Submit application on WCD portal
steps.description: Upload child photograph, mother bank details, and immunization card.

steps.title: Issuance of National Savings Certificate / FD
steps.description: Government purchases fixed deposit in the girl child's name with phased payouts at 6th, 9th, and 12th class milestones.

steps.title: Maturity payout on turning 18
steps.description: Full maturity amount released when the girl passes class 12 and attains age 18 as an unmarried citizen.
